verdict.rationale: The evidence shows RingCentral publishes its own MCP servers and connects to external LLMs such as ChatGPT and Claude. That is the server role, a different story. Nothing shows RingCentral or its Agentic Voice AI acting as an MCP client that can register third-party MCP servers and call their tools. The axis plausibly applies to an AI-enabled platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
